description: Dashed border (9.22.0, «style.border.style: 'dashed'», «x-style.layout.borderDash»). The centre line of the border, half a width inside the outer edge, with the corner radii scaled down as CSS does and then reduced by half a width; dashes of 3 and gaps of 2 widths, the count rounded so the loop closes evenly. Numbers to six decimals; the readers compare them within 1e-5. Radii are logical; right-to-left mirrors the drawing.

lineCases.name: a square box 102 × 52 with a 2 border: the centre line is 100 × 50, 30 steps of 10, nothing stretched
the code card: 345 × 82, a 1 border, radius 18 — dashes follow the arcs, the count rounds and stretches evenly
a circle: 40 × 40, a 2 border, radius 30 does not fit and is scaled down to 20 as CSS does
a radius smaller than half the border: the centre line has a square corner
corners of their own: top start and bottom end rounded
a box with no border width draws nothing

pathCases.name: the square box: the path starts at the inline start of the top edge and goes to the end
rounded corners are arcs of the centre-line radius
